import random
def gen(seed=7, ncomm=12, nsnap=4, nobs=64, maxf=3, ndom=14):
    random.seed(seed)
    nodes=['n%d'%i for i in range(12)]
    edges=[]
    for i in range(32):
        a=random.randrange(12); b=random.randrange(12)
        while b==a: b=random.randrange(12)
        edges.append(('e%d'%i,'n%d'%a,'n%d'%b,1000000))
    commodities=[]
    for i in range(ncomm):
        a=random.randrange(12); b=random.randrange(12)
        while b==a: b=random.randrange(12)
        # find path via random walk on edges
        routes=[]; cur='n%d'%a
        for _ in range(10):
            if cur=='n%d'%b: break
            cand=[e for e in edges if e[1]==cur]
            if not cand: break
            e=random.choice(cand); routes.append(([e[0]],random.randint(1,3))); cur=e[2]
        if cur=='n%d'%b and routes:
            commodities.append(('c%d'%i,'n%d'%a,'n%d'%b,routes))
    domains=['d%d'%i for i in range(ndom)]
    snapshots=[]
    for s in range(nsnap):
        bounds=[(0,10000) for _ in commodities]
        obs=[]
        for i in range(nobs):
            m=random.choice(['demand','link','ingress','egress'])
            if m=='demand': t=random.choice(commodities)[0]
            elif m=='link': t=random.choice(edges)[0]
            else: t=random.choice(nodes)
            obs.append((m,t,0,10000, random.choice(domains+[None])))
        snapshots.append((bounds,[0]*len(commodities),0,obs))
    return nodes,edges,commodities,domains,maxf,snapshots
